data.body: Parallel acceleration authorized. Live epic recount: 55/117 leaf tasks closed; 62 remain (7 in_progress, 52 open, 3 blocked). Kept claimed leaf necessary-subtle-cooter in the coordinator worktree. Selected three additional next-batch leaves with pairwise-disjoint impacts and no exact overlap against any live in_progress impact: unable-wingless-bustard (src/rebar cohort 01), felicitous-sourdough-capybara (reconciler cohort 02), and congenial-cibophobic-goosefish (scripts cohort 03). Each previously passed signed plan review, but its certificate is stale-code on current origin/main; each worker is authorized to run only that one necessary refresh, recheck conflicts, claim on PASS, and prepare the documentation-only change. Pushes remain serialized under the project-wide one-pending-CI rule.
